title: 'Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo, Theme Songs
content: The official website of the Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ( I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ) television anime revealed two additional cast, the theme songs, a second key visual (pictured), and a second promotional video on Friday.

title: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in a Different World as an Aristocrat Season 2's Video Reveals More Cast, January Debut
content: Kadokawa streamed the first main promotional video and first key visual for the second television anime season based on Rui Tsukiyo and Reia 's The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in a Different World as an Aristocrat ( Sekai Saikō no Ansatsusha, Isekai Kizoku ni Tensei Suru ) light novel series on Friday.

title: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner Anime's Video Reveals More Cast, Theme Songs, October 4 TV Debut
content: The official website for the short anime of Shaoh 's I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ( Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ) manga unveiled the main promotional video and visual for the anime on Friday.

title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2's Video Unveils Theme Songs, October 11 Debut
content: The staff for the anime of Hitsuji Gondaira 's Mission: Yozakura Family ( Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ) manga unveiled a new promotional video and visual for the second part of the anime's second season on Friday.

title: Live-Action Look Back Film's Clip Highlights Kyōmoto, Fujino Creating Manga
content: The official website for the live-action film of Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot manga presented a new clip from the film on Friday. The clip shows Kyōmoto and Fujino creating a manga together.
author: ANN

title: Konami's Project Zircon Deckbuilding Roguelike Game Streams New Teaser
content: Konami presented a new teaser trailer for its Project Zircon deckbuilding roguelike game during its Konami Press Start livestream on Thursday. The trailer previews gameplay footage for the game, but does not announce a release date. The game now has a Steam page , confirming a planned release for PC.
author: ANN

title: Dark Gathering Season 2 to Release in 2027, First Horror Visual Revealed
content: Dark Gathering Season 2 revealed the first in a series of new “horror visuals,” along with confirming a 2027 release date. Studio OLM was previously confirmed to be returning to animate, with Hiroshi Ikehata as director.
author: Anime Corner
